narrative:
The FY2027 business-unit revenue plan is GBP 3.80B across five business units, up 6.3% on the FY2026 forecast of GBP 3.58B. This is the first BU cycle running on Snowflake instead of Oracle EPM: targets cascade from the group ambition of GBP 3.85B down to service line and region, with every override written to a governed audit trail.

UK Insurance remains the anchor at GBP 2.01B (53% of revenue), led by Corporate PMI at GBP 1.25B. The fastest growth is in provision: Clinics & Hospitals grow 13% to GBP 350M as NHS waiting lists push self-pay demand into Cromwell Hospital and the new health clinics, and private dental membership grows 9%.

Key point for the CFO team: the gap to ambition is GBP 50M, and the agent has three proposals worth GBP 82M ready for review. Each one shows its drivers, so nothing reaches the plan as an unexplained AI number.

signals.title: Oracle EPM BU Planning Paused
signals.excerpt: Business-unit planning on Oracle EPM has been paused. Group planning already runs on Snowflake after the TM1 to Anaplan to Snowflake migration delivered with EY.

signals.title: NHS Elective Waiting List Above 7 Million
signals.excerpt: Referral-to-treatment waiting times continue to drive self-pay and PMI demand for diagnostics, orthopaedics and cataract procedures.

signals.title: Reporting Migration to Snowflake + Sigma
signals.excerpt: Business Objects reporting is moving to Snowflake with Sigma, giving finance input grids, workflow and write-back on governed data.
